name: What should I prepare before requesting a built-in shelving estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a built-in shelving estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking an on-site consultation, decide what you intend to store, measure oversized items like large art books or audio receivers, and note whether you prefer open shelving, closed lower cabinets, or a combination. Take rough dimensions of the wall area, including ceiling height, and note any obstructions such as baseboard heaters, floor vents, wall switches, or return air grilles. It is also helpful to identify your preferred finish—whether that is matching existing room trim, choosing a contrasting painted accent color, or a natural wood stain. Having these details ready helps establish accurate framing specifications and material allowances right from the initial walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure your space, list what you plan to store, identify nearby vents or outlets, and decide whether you want open shelving, lower doors, paint, or stain.
